text.en:
Item (af), under "(27) Leyte," paragraph f, section two of Republic Act Numbered Sixteen hundred thirteen, is amended to read as follows:
"(af) For the construction of the Bahay, Liloan, Leyte, barrio school building ₱5,000.00 "(ag) For the completion of Nueva Estrella school building, Pintuyan, Leyte ₱5,000.00"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 22, 1957.
